trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.summary: Collect all 54 other trophies to unlock the Platinum.
trophies.guide: Unlock every other trophy in Grand Theft Auto VI. Sourced from PowerPyx & Exophase complete completion guides. No online trophies required for platinum.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatically unlocked during the prologue in Vice City. Follow the opening cinematic and introductory driving segment. Source: PowerPyx Walkthrough.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish all required story missions in Chapter 1. Cannot be missed. Source: Exophase Guide.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Progress through the narrative to the end of Chapter 2. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 story arc across Vice City and surrounding Leonida swamplands. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Reach the conclusion of Chapter 4 missions. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.summary: Complete the grand finale final mission.
trophies.guide: Beat the final story mission of the campaign. Ensure you are well-stocked on armor and heavy weapons before triggering the point of no return. Source: PowerPyx & Exophase.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story progression mission early in the game. Warning: Missable if you fail to complete specific prompt interactions before advancing the main cartel arc. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Major heist mission mid-game. Warning: Can be missed if crew selection lock triggers without prior setup completion. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the narrative mission Child's Play. Warning: Missable during Chapter 2 if side objectives are bypassed before moving to Act 2. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story mission. Warning: Missable if story progression blocks prior side dialogue triggers. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Intercept the transport vehicle during VCIA Takedown. Warning: Missable during the airport perimeter lockdown phase. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Assault the compound in Operation Savage Glory. Warning: Missable if you trigger the final assault without meeting intelligence prerequisites. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Complete all main missions, stranger missions, collectibles, random events, and side activities. Check your progress in the pause menu tracker. Source: PowerPyx 100% Guide.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 unique stunt jumps using fast motorcycles or sports cars. Use a map marker guide to track locations. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.summary: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Participate in all 9 distinct side activities available in Leonida (racing, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling, etc.). Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.summary: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Master gunplay and target accuracy across all 42 Shooting Range challenges in Ammu-Nation and gun clubs. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.summary: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win drone racing minigames at all 14 designated spots. Practice tight cornering and boost timing. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Place 1st in 20 unique street and off-road races. Upgrade your vehicles beforehand. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.summary: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Catch a heavier fish than Cal at the Everglades dock. Warning: Missable if you ignore Cal's invite before the swamp mission arc closes. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play and finish any full arcade cabinet in the boardwalk arcade. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.summary: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish all encounter strands for the stranger Andy. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.summary: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's multi-part stranger questline. Warning: Missable if Kenton's mission chain expires after story progression. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.summary: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Assist Billy across all his biker encounters. Warning: Missable if biker camp is raided before completing Billy's final task. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.summary: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE if ignored before endgame point of no return for certain characters. Complete 8 full stranger questlines across the state. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.summary: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's smuggling stranger missions. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.summary: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's street culture stranger strand. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.summary: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Find and complete meditation sessions at all 18 scenic viewpoints. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.summary: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track and bag the legendary beast in the Leonida backcountry for Bret. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect all cards for 3 separate in-game trading card collections hidden throughout Vice City. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Interact with and check in at 100 tourist hotspots using the in-game WAiNK social app. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 open-world gameplay challenges (headshots, distance driven, near misses, etc.). Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.summary: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Evade police search cones while at 4 stars with your co-op partner in the vehicle. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.summary: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Sustain a continuous crime spree holding a wanted level across 3 consecutive shop robberies. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Drive or inspect 100 unique vehicle models across Leonida. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.summary: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger special Combat Focus ability and score 5 quick eliminations before the meter depletes. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.summary: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Flee the Vice City International Airport security lockdown in a stolen aircraft. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Disable or destroy military Rhino tanks during a high-heat encounter. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.summary: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Use stealth takedowns and silencers to clean out a jewelry shop before alarms trigger. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Plan and successfully execute 5 bank vault robberies across Leonida and escape clean. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.summary: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Ambush and crack an armored security transport on the highway. Warning: Missable if special event window passes during late game storyline shifts. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Uncover the fog of war across all 52 distinct regions of the map. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.summary: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Target and raid at least one illicit stash house or drug den for all 9 rival gangs. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.summary: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Visit the Ocean Beach lounge at sunset and order a signature drink. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.summary: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the luxury supercar and crash straight through the glass showroom windows. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.summary: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full frame of bowling at the downtown alley. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Set a new cooperative challenge record with your partner. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Accumulate 50 significant dialogue and action choices throughout campaign events. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed at a mission objective immediately after a retry checkpoint. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Investigate the mysterious UFO Easter egg site in the swamps at 3:00 AM. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.summary: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock down a pedestrian or enemy using a melee strike while driving a motorcycle. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.summary: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Successfully clean $250,000 in illegal cash through front businesses. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Buy clothes, weapons, and vehicle mods totaling $100,000 at merchants. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 safehouse garage properties across Vice City. Source: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.summary: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Scan and register 10 different motor scooters into the Scooter Bros rental network. Source: Exophase.
